purpose: bounded read-and-fix review of all canonical t(...) pairs in chronomancy and command-staff chat sections
note: Every canonical t(...) pair in the listed sections is in scope. No entry is asserted defective. Host source verification decides. args_order is recorded per call.

items.source: What kind of anomaly do you prefer?
items.target: 你喜欢哪种异常？

items.source: Physical
items.target: 物理

items.source: Warp
items.target: 翘曲

items.source: Temporal
items.target: 时空

items.source: Never mind
items.target: 没事，别介意。

items.source: #PURPLE#A paradox has already destroyed other timelines!
items.target: #PURPLE#一个时空紊乱摧毁了其他时间线!

items.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You select the timeline and re-arrange the universe to your liking!
items.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你选择了时间线，依照你喜欢的方式重组了这个世界！

items.source: You have lived %d turns in three different timelines. Which do you choose to be the real timeline?
items.target: 你在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合，你选择哪一条成为现实时间线？

items.source: The first.
items.target: 第一条。

items.source: The second.
items.target: 第二条。

items.source: The third.
items.target: 第三条。

items.source: Greetings. How can I help you?
items.target: 你好，我能帮你什么忙么？

items.source: Hurry up and make with the foe-blasting.
items.target: 快点，我们要去把敌人打爆。

items.source: O wise wielder, instruct me that I may better serve you.
items.target: 睿智的持杖者，请指示我让我更好地为您服务。

items.source: Make amends, magic-user, for the harm ye have wrought is beyond compare.
items.target: 赎罪吧，法师们，你们带来了罄竹难书的危害。

items.source: You really could have chosen a better home for me, you know. I was reasonably happy in my old crystal. This stick smells like armpit.
items.target: 要知道，你可以给我找个更好的环境。我原本在我的旧水晶里住得挺舒服的。这根法杖有一股狐臭的味道。

items.source: Tremble before the might of Telos!
items.target: 在泰勒斯的强大力量下颤抖吧！

items.source: It is not yet your place to command such a staff as this. To do so invites obliteration.
items.target: 你还没有资格掌控这支法杖；强行去做只会招致毁灭。

items.source: Call on which aspect of the staff?
items.target: 召唤哪种法杖的元素力量？

items.source: error!
items.target: 错误！

items.source: Oh, I was once a mighty Eldritch Channeler. Mighty and absentminded, as it turns out. Had a bit of a mishap with an Inverted Kugala's Soul-infusion technique. Long story short, my soul is now stuck in this stick, and the soul I was working with... well, I don't rightly know where he got to. But I hope we never meet him.
items.target: 哦，我曾经是一位强大的埃尔德里奇主宰者。事实证明，那时的我强大而健忘。有一次，我在倒转库加拉灵魂灌注术时出了点岔子。长话短说吧，我的灵魂如今被困在这根法杖里，而我当时正在处理的那个灵魂……嗯，我也不太清楚他跑到哪里去了。但我希望我们永远不会遇到他。

items.source: Argh! Bollocksed up a tricky bit of soul magic and the fool that I was supposed to be imprisoning for all eternity flitted away. My body, like all the targets of my spells, intended or otherwise, got reduced to elementary particles. Fortunately, I had this soul-cage of a staff all prepped and ready for a stray soul, so I'm not completely gone. But enough chit-chat. Let's fry somebody.
items.target: 啊！我搞砸了一个棘手的灵魂法术，本该被我永久囚禁的那个蠢货趁机溜走了。我的身体，和所有被我法术波及的东西一样，无论有意还是无意，都被分解成了基本粒子。幸运的是，我早已备好这根灵魂牢笼法杖，随时欢迎流浪的灵魂入住，所以我还没有彻底完蛋。好了，闲话少说，去烤个人吧！

items.source: My old master-- who, though a powerful enchanter, did not compare to you and your glory-- saw fit to imprison me in this fine staff to aid him in his work. Alas, he is long gone, but I despair not, for I have found a mighty new master.
items.target: 我的旧主人——虽然他的法术很强大，但却比不上你和你的荣耀——他认为，把我囚禁在这根法杖里可以为他更好的服务。唉，虽然他已经不复存在了，但我并不感到绝望，因为我找到了一个强大的新主人。

items.source: I am a portion of the very spirit of the world that was ripped free during the Spellblaze. I speak that I might enlighten those who bear me.
items.target: 我是世界之灵在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂出的一部分。我可以教导给你所需的知识，只要你愿意聆听我。

items.source: What's the good of immortality if you can't even speak? No archmage worth his salt is going to concoct some immoral life-after-death scheme without including some sort of capacity for making his opinions known. And, by the way, your energy manipulation techniques are on the same level as those of my average pair of shoes. Best study up if you don't want to die forgotten and incompetent.
items.target: 如果不能说话，那这样的永生还有何意义？但凡有点本事的大法师，在策划某种死后续命的邪恶计划时，都会给自己留一条表达意见的途径。顺便说一句，你的能量操纵水平跟我那双普通鞋子差不多。不想默默无闻地死得不明不白，就好好学着点。

items.source: Of course. Which aspect?
items.target: 当然。哪个方面？

items.source: I highly recommend the mage aspect and the fire element. You're not going to find anything better for turning a piece of meat into a cloud of vapor.
items.target: 我强烈推荐法师领域和火焰元素。你不会找到比这更好的能让一块肉变成蒸汽的方法了。

items.source: I live to serve-- though my use of the word 'live' is perhaps loose here.
items.target: 我毕生为你效劳——虽然“毕生”在这里对于我而言并不是那么准确。

items.source: Choose wisely. Powers beyond your comprehension will tolerate only so much interference in their carefully-laid natural order.
items.target: 明智地进行选择。那些超越你理解的力量，对它们精心安排的自然秩序所受的干涉，忍耐是有限的。

items.source: Back in my day, we didn't need to go changing our staves around willy-nilly. We picked an element and stuck with it, by the gods.
items.target: 在我那个年代，我们不会随便更换法杖。选定一种元素就用到底，诸神在上。

items.source: Certainly. You should be impressed, by the way, that I can do such a thing. Most lesser practitioners of my art would have difficulties with this. What shall I change?
items.target: 当然。顺带一提，我可以做的事情会让你印象深刻。大多数技艺不如我的同行都会觉得难以做到。你想让我改变什么？

items.source: Fine, as long as it leads to blasting something soon. What do you want me to change?
items.target: 很好，只要它能快速的引爆某物。你要我换成什么？

items.source: Choose different aspect
items.target: 选择其他领域

items.source: Never mind.
items.target: 算了。

items.source: Call forth which element?
items.target: 召唤哪种元素

items.source: staff
items.target: 法杖

items.source: How is it that you speak?
items.target: 你居然能说话？

items.source: I'd like you to bring forth a different aspect.
items.target: 我希望切换到其他领域。

items.source: I'd like to alter your basic properties.
items.target: 我希望改变你的基础属性。

items.source: I see.
items.target: 我知道了
